high_level_description: The image is a comparative analysis of the share of global manufacturing exports for India and Vietnam over time. The background is black with white text, making the content stand out clearly. Introduction: The text at the top states that Vietnam is 7% of India's population but has a higher share than India in global manufacturing exports. Comparison: It highlights that despite India claiming significant manufacturing growth over the last 10 years, Vietnam has outperformed India during this period. Graph Title: The graph is titled "Share of Global Manufacturing Exports (%)".
